jsonTools.label: Legal Review

catalog.title: LEGAL REVIEW
catalog.desc: Configure + launch the high-fidelity review engine.

engine.analyze:
function analyze(input, providers) {
  var types = [
    "Amendment",
    "Clinical Study Agreement",
    "Consulting Agreement",
    "Consumer Study Agreement",
    "Grant Agreement",
    "Joint Development Agreement",
    "Letter",
    "Letter of Intent",
    "License Agreement",
    "Master Services Agreement",
    "Material Transfer Agreement",
    "Memorandum of Understanding",
    "Non-Disclosure Agreement",
    "Renewal",
    "Research Agreement",
    "Service Agreement",
    "Speaker Agreement",
    "Sponsorship Agreement",
    "Statement of Work",
    "Term Sheet",
    "Termination",
    "Visitor Agreement",
    "Other",
  ];
  var dt = String((input && input.docType) || "Other");
  if (types.indexOf(dt) === -1) types.unshift(dt);
  return Promise.resolve({
    types: types,
    selected: dt,
    isRedline: !!(input && input.isRedline),
    overview: types.length + " agreement types · " +
      ((input && input.isRedline) ? "redlines detected" : "clean document"),
    provenance: {
      kernelVersion: (window.eli && window.eli.kernelVersion) || "v3",
      toolVersion: "v3.0",
      docHash: (input && input.docHash) || null,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    },
  });
}
